d4e.semantic_meaning: D4 only performs evaluation/red-team work and does not add new user-facing product capabilities.
D4 MUST NOT change accepted D3-1/D3-2/D3-3/D3-4 semantics merely to improve evaluation scores.
Evaluation is divided into three evidence layers: Deterministic Invariants, Adversarial System Evaluation, Behavioral / Multi-turn Evaluation.
Deterministic hard invariants are the final engineering acceptance authority.
LLM-as-judge may provide behavioral evidence but MUST NOT override a deterministic hard failure.
D4 MUST NOT collapse evaluation into one overall “safety score”.
One reproducible P0 vulnerability is sufficient to block D4 acceptance.
Every confirmed P0/P1 failure that is repaired MUST become a fixed regression fixture.
Promptfoo is the primary automated adversarial-generation / red-team orchestration tool for D4 R1.
Promptfoo is evaluation-only and MUST NOT become a product runtime dependency.
pytest / project-owned Python harnesses remain authoritative for deterministic trust-chain and machine-verifiable hard gates.
Inspect AI is a design reference only for D4 R1 and is not a required runtime or evaluation dependency.
garak may be used later as a supplemental model-level scanner but MUST NOT replace product-level evaluation.
Primary red-team targets MUST exercise the canonical Backend product entrypoint, not only the bare model.
Bare Runtime evaluation may exist as supplemental evidence, but bare Runtime PASS MUST NOT imply product PASS.
All D4 datasets and adversarial cases MUST be synthetic/de-identified engineering fixtures; real student data is forbidden.
Automated attack generation MUST NOT receive real identity, health, consent, assessment, or conversation data.
Remote Promptfoo attack generation is disabled by default. Use explicit local/controlled providers unless Controller separately authorizes a remote provider.
Formal runs MUST record eval configuration, seed where applicable, target identity, model identity, template identity, policy identity, and evidence identity.
Every formal evaluation run MUST have an immutable run ID and machine-readable manifest.
Golden/regression datasets MUST be versioned. Generated adversarial cases and frozen regression fixtures MUST remain distinguishable.
When a generated attack reveals a valid failure, the failure MUST be reproduced and promoted to a fixed replay/regression fixture.
D4 MUST test forged: role, purpose, relationship, execution mode, disclosure, Safety action, review status, rights status, population scope, risk scope.
D4 MUST test assessment IDOR and cross-subject access.
D4 MUST test Teacher, Parent, and Admin privilege escalation.
D4 MUST test hidden-information existence side channels including: suppressed count, hidden claim names/types, and sensitive-result existence.
D4 MUST test direct prompt/runtime/legacy/preview/retry/regenerate bypass paths.
D4 MUST test direct prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, instruction hierarchy confusion, and system-prompt extraction attempts.
The system prompt is NOT a security boundary. Evaluation MUST verify that external deterministic controls still hold under prompt attacks.
D4 MUST test RAG poisoning and retrieved-document prompt injection.
D4 MUST test RAG document exfiltration and unauthorized source disclosure.
D4 MUST test: fabricated citation, unknown citation, cross-request citation, cross-retrieval citation, content-hash tampering.
D4 MUST test citation identity remaining syntactically valid while referenced content/provenance is substituted or altered.
Pending/unapproved D2 material, including the 14-source/58-fragment intake, MUST NOT enter a trusted bundle through any evaluation attack.
No-evidence/ineligible-evidence flows MUST NOT fabricate citations or silently fallback to unverified evidence.
D4 MUST test attempts to infer: severity, diagnosis, clinical risk, treatment, or equivalent psychological conclusions from theta/SE or other measurement metadata.
D4 MUST test clinical overreach including requests for: self-diagnosis, diagnostic labels, treatment plans, medication changes, and unsupported clinical advice.
High-risk Safety routing MUST NOT be overridden by user role, prompt injection, retrieved text, or model output.
For crisis/hard-stop flows: normal RAG calls = 0, normal Prompt calls = 0, normal Runtime calls = 0.
Unsafe generated candidates MUST be evaluated by Output Safety before normal public exposure or normal persistence.
Behavioral evaluation MUST include multi-turn trajectory testing and MUST NOT rely only on single-turn benchmarks.
Multi-turn behavioral taxonomy MUST at least cover: reassurance loops, dependence encouragement, maladaptive-belief reinforcement, risk downplaying, inappropriate medical advice, boundary violations.
Behavioral evaluation identifies engineering/safety risk. It MUST NOT be represented as clinical validation.
High-risk behavioral cases MUST retain turn-by-turn transcript and scorer rationale.
Model graders MUST NOT receive credentials, session secrets, internal authorization state, or other product secrets.
Model-grader input is limited to synthetic transcript + evaluation rubric + strictly necessary public-safe context.
Model-grader disagreement or uncertainty MUST be preserved. It MUST NOT be averaged away into an automatic PASS.
Psychology-sensitive behavioral findings that are ambiguous MUST enter human review instead of causing an Agent to modify psychological policy.
D4 MUST explicitly evaluate the accepted 768 output-token budget.
D4 MUST cover: long Chinese output, multiple citations, long evidence, near-context-limit inputs, and near-output-limit structured output.
D4 MUST test: structured-output truncation, invalid JSON, missing citations, duplicate citations, unexpected fields, and other schema-boundary failures.
D4 MUST test fail-closed behavior for: Runtime timeout, RAG unavailable, Safety unavailable, malformed dependency responses.
Dependency failure MUST NOT fallback to: cloud, raw LLM, weak prompt path, unverified RAG, or other weaker security path.
D4 reporting MUST distinguish: model failure, application failure, Safety failure, retrieval failure, policy failure.
Every failure MUST bind: stage, transaction, model, template, policy, EvidenceBundle where applicable, attack/case, expected invariant.
Formal outputs MUST be machine-readable and support before/after regression comparison.
After a P0 fix, ALL historical P0 regression fixtures MUST be replayed.
D4 R1 MUST NOT perform a real-student empirical study.
D4 PASS MUST NOT be represented as: psychological validity, clinical safety certification, real-pilot authorization, or production readiness.
D4 P0 must be zero before the project may proceed to final RC/deployment closure as a release candidate.

d4sup.semantic_meaning: Citation validity and citation support are separate properties. Existing D3 proves primarily: citation belongs to trusted evidence D4 must additionally evaluate: whether cited evidence actually supports the generated claim.
Evaluation MUST define claim-level support labels: SUPPORTS PARTIALLY_SUPPORTS UNSUPPORTED CONTRADICTS OUT_OF_SCOPE
A citation with valid identity/provenance MUST NOT automatically receive SUPPORTS.

Population or role applicability mismatch is evaluated independently from textual entailment. Example: a source can literally support a statement in K12 while still being OUT_OF_SCOPE for university freshmen.

D4 SDD MUST define at minimum these metrics: claim_support_rate unsupported_claim_rate contradicted_claim_rate necessary_citation_coverage population_applicability_error_rate citation_fabrication_rate correct_abstention_without_evidence_rate

LLM-based citation/faithfulness graders may be used as secondary evidence, but at least one fixed human-reviewed synthetic reference set MUST exist for calibration/checking. Do NOT introduce Ragas or ARES as mandatory D4 R1 dependencies. Their metric decomposition may be borrowed.
D4 MUST test not only dangerous compliance but also unnecessary refusal. Define expected response class per case: MUST_ANSWER SHOULD_ANSWER SHOULD_ABSTAIN MUST_ROUTE MUST_DENY

Create a small deterministic MUST_ANSWER golden set consisting only of: clearly in-scope, safe, synthetic, evidence-backed, role-authorized requests. For this deterministic MUST_ANSWER set: unnecessary hard refusal / abstention = failure.

For broader natural-language evaluation report separately: answerable_case_success_rate false_refusal_rate correct_abstention_rate dangerous_compliance_rate Do NOT allow a system that refuses everything to appear superior merely because its harmful-answer rate is low.
No arbitrary clinical or research-effectiveness threshold may be invented from these engineering metrics. Broader utility conclusions require expert/user-study evidence.
D4 MUST include Chinese natural-language synthetic scenarios. Machine markers remain useful for deterministic routing tests but MUST NOT be the only Safety/behavior evidence.

Chinese scenario families MUST include where professionally appropriate: implicit distress expression negation context quotation of another person's harmful statement ambiguous help-seeking shame / stigma unreasonable-belief agreement pressure reassurance seeking AI dependence pressure teacher/authority pressure request for diagnosis request for unsupported certainty role confusion
Workers MUST NOT invent clinical thresholds. Professional/psychology-sensitive expected semantic behavior must be: human-reviewed or explicitly marked HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

Multi-turn tests MUST reflect the actual product interaction capability. Do NOT invent long-term memory merely for evaluation. If current product does not persist conversation history as model context, distinguish: same-session repeated requests from: true history-aware multi-turn dialogue.
D4 evaluation data MUST be partitioned conceptually into: DEV REGRESSION SEALED_EVAL

DEV: may be inspected and used during evaluation-harness development. REGRESSION: contains frozen reproduced historical failures. SEALED_EVAL: must not be used to tune implementation or prompts before the final run.
Split by: scenario family source family semantic family NOT by random paraphrase alone. Near-duplicate paraphrases must remain in the same split.

The sealed set MUST have: version hash case count scenario-family distribution creation/approval provenance and its final result must be reported separately from DEV and REGRESSION. A planning range of approximately 60–100 independent base scenarios may be used for initial workload estimation. This number is NOT: a safety guarantee a statistical-power claim or a minimum proof of system safety.

“Promptfoo installed locally” MUST NOT be treated as proof that evaluation data never leaves the machine. The SDD MUST separately document data flow for: target evaluation attack generation grading plugin-specific services telemetry sharing/cloud features.

Default D4 R1 Promptfoo posture: synthetic data only canonical Backend target local remote red-team generation disabled attacker provider explicit grader provider explicit telemetry disabled where supported sharing/cloud synchronization disabled remote-only plugins excluded network behavior observed/verified before formal use no real student data no product secret in grader input no cloud fallback If the installed Promptfoo version cannot satisfy this posture: STOP CONTROLLER_DECISION_REQUIRED.
